boundaries: Existing supported Trainer programs are unchanged; fallback applies only to previously unsupported whole texts.
Only reviewed rule IDs and atomic player actions are shared; before-attack timing, damage metadata, Pokemon SELF and unknown conditions remain excluded.
Hidden deck searches allow failure-to-find; public recovery keeps a mandatory minimum clamped to eligible cards.
Forced switch belongs to the affected player; gust belongs to the effect controller.
Draw condition binds actual cards drawn, including partial draw, and cannot fire with an empty deck.
Coin-driven searches and attachments retain their original result and ownership; no ordinary Energy attachment is consumed.
Resolving Trainer is excluded from its own shuffle or discard search.
